        if diff[i] > min_diff and diff[i] < second_min_diff:
            second_min_diff = diff[i]
            second_min_index = i
    
    # Calculate the potential new sums after swapping
    if max_index != min_index:
        potential_sum1 = initial_sum - max_diff + min_diff

        potential_sum1 = initial_sum

        potential_sum2 = initial_sum - second_max_diff + second_min_diff

        potential_sum2 = initial_sum
